name: app.lonepair/lonepair
title: Lone Pair
description: Draws chemical structures and reactions as journal-style figures; converts and analyses molecules.

tools.name: draw
tools.description: Draw a chemical structure or reaction as a publication-style figure (ChemDraw-like skeletal formula) with the Lone Pair editor's renderer. Give SMILES, reaction SMILES, InChI, a molfile, a ChemDraw file, or a compound name with name=true. Refused, with the reason, instead of drawn wrongly: SMILES that cannot be read, aromatic rings that cannot alternate single and double bonds, and atoms with too many bonds (unless `as_written`). The result carries `drawing` (Lone Pair JSON to pass to edit_drawing or back in as `input`) and `notes` (anything changed on reading or lost in the format). The SVG and PNG hold the drawing inside them, so they reopen for editing at lonepair.app.

input.description: The structure as text: SMILES, reaction SMILES (reactants>agents>products), InChI, a molfile, RXN, SD file, CDXML, CML or Marvin text, or a Lone Pair drawing (the JSON from an earlier result, or the SVG text of an earlier figure).

name.description: Set to true when `input` is a compound name (e.g. "aspirin") rather than a structure. The name is sent to PubChem to find the structure; this is the only network call the server makes. Default false.

as_written.description: Draw atoms that have too many bonds instead of refusing the structure. Default false.

format.description: png (default; returned as an image), svg (returned as text), pdf or eps (returned as base64 in `data_base64`).

style.description: Journal style. acs = ACS Document 1996 (default), rsc = RSC, nature = Nature Reviews, slides = heavier lines for slides.

dpi.description: PNG resolution, 300 by default; 600 for print.

opaque.description: White background instead of transparent (SVG, PNG). Default false.

tools.name: render_reaction
tools.description: Draw a reaction scheme from its parts: reactants joined by plus signs, an arrow with optional text above and below, then products. Each structure is SMILES, InChI or a molfile. For a reaction already written as reaction SMILES, use draw. Refused, with the reason, instead of drawn wrongly: SMILES that cannot be read, aromatic rings that cannot alternate single and double bonds, and atoms with too many bonds (unless `as_written`). The result carries `drawing` (Lone Pair JSON to pass to edit_drawing or back in as `input`) and `notes` (anything changed on reading or lost in the format).

above.description: Text above the arrow: reagents or catalyst. Digits after letters become subscripts (H2SO4).

below.description: Text below the arrow: solvent, temperature, time.

as_written.description: Draw atoms that have too many bonds instead of refusing the structure. Default false.

format.description: png (default; returned as an image), svg (returned as text), pdf or eps (returned as base64 in `data_base64`).

style.description: Journal style. acs = ACS Document 1996 (default), rsc = RSC, nature = Nature Reviews, slides = heavier lines for slides.

dpi.description: PNG resolution, 300 by default; 600 for print.

opaque.description: White background instead of transparent (SVG, PNG). Default false.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert a structure between formats: cdxml, cdx, mol, molV3, sdf, rxn, rxnV3, smiles, inchi, inchikey, cml, mrv, json (mol = V2000 molfile, molV3 = V3000, json = Lone Pair drawing). Reads ChemDraw CDXML and CDX. `notes` says what the target format cannot keep (for example dative bonds in a V2000 molfile). Refused, with the reason, instead of drawn wrongly: SMILES that cannot be read, aromatic rings that cannot alternate single and double bonds, and atoms with too many bonds (unless `as_written`).

input.description: The structure as text: SMILES, reaction SMILES (reactants>agents>products), InChI, a molfile, RXN, SD file, CDXML, CML or Marvin text, or a Lone Pair drawing (the JSON from an earlier result, or the SVG text of an earlier figure).

name.description: Set to true when `input` is a compound name (e.g. "aspirin") rather than a structure. The name is sent to PubChem to find the structure; this is the only network call the server makes. Default false.

as_written.description: Draw atoms that have too many bonds instead of refusing the structure. Default false.

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: For each structure in the input: molecular formula, molecular weight, exact (monoisotopic) mass, elemental analysis, SMILES, InChI and InChIKey. For a reaction: each structure's role and whether atoms and charge balance (each drawn structure counted once). Calculated from the structure, not looked up. NMR, pKa and mass-spectrum estimates are not part of this tool.

input.description: The structure as text: SMILES, reaction SMILES (reactants>agents>products), InChI, a molfile, RXN, SD file, CDXML, CML or Marvin text, or a Lone Pair drawing (the JSON from an earlier result, or the SVG text of an earlier figure).

name.description: Set to true when `input` is a compound name (e.g. "aspirin") rather than a structure. The name is sent to PubChem to find the structure; this is the only network call the server makes. Default false.

as_written.description: Draw atoms that have too many bonds instead of refusing the structure. Default false.

tools.name: edit_drawing
tools.description: Change a figure Lone Pair made earlier and get the new figure: add a structure to the right of it, change the journal style, or put a caption under it. Give the earlier result's `drawing`. Everything else in the drawing stays as it was. Moving or deleting atoms is not supported; draw the structure again instead. The result carries `drawing` (Lone Pair JSON to pass to edit_drawing or back in as `input`) and `notes` (anything changed on reading or lost in the format).

drawing.description: The `drawing` object from an earlier result.

add.description: A structure to add to the right of the drawing (SMILES, InChI, molfile).

add_is_name.description: True when `add` is a compound name to look up at PubChem. Default false.

caption.description: Text to put under the drawing.

format.description: png (default; returned as an image), svg (returned as text), pdf or eps (returned as base64 in `data_base64`).

style.description: Journal style. acs = ACS Document 1996 (default), rsc = RSC, nature = Nature Reviews, slides = heavier lines for slides.

dpi.description: PNG resolution, 300 by default; 600 for print.

opaque.description: White background instead of transparent (SVG, PNG). Default false.
